metadata.selection: previously identified top 5 best IP2P-edited images

samples.scene_summary: celebration scene viewed through phone screen with cluttered building background
samples.old_ip2p_prompt: However, the background featuring buildings appears visually cluttered and lacks cohesion, potentially diminishing the focal point's prominence
samples.new_caption: a photo of hands holding a smartphone displaying a vibrant celebration scene, with a soft bokeh urban background, sharp focus on the phone screen, professional photography, balanced composition
samples.aesthetic_target: blur background, emphasize phone screen subject

samples.scene_summary: green mountains with distant flags against vast sky
samples.old_ip2p_prompt: the vast expanse of the sky be perceived as less visually engaging. A potential adjustment to decrease the prominence of the sky could substantially enhance
samples.new_caption: a photo of lush green mountains with colorful prayer flags and distant peaks, captured during golden hour with warm soft lighting, balanced sky-to-mountain composition, vivid colors, professional landscape photography
samples.aesthetic_target: warm golden hour lighting, balanced composition

samples.scene_summary: bare tree branches silhouetted against blue sky
samples.old_ip2p_prompt: While the simplicity and clarity of the image are commendable, there exists a subtle monotony that could be addressed by either introduce additional elements or exploring alternative angles
samples.new_caption: a photo of bare tree branches silhouetted against a deep blue sky, with warm golden afternoon light highlighting the branches, dramatic contrast, fine art photography, vivid natural colors
samples.aesthetic_target: warm light, contrast enhancement, keep color (avoid B&W conversion)

samples.scene_summary: monochromatic boats on water surface with sky
samples.old_ip2p_prompt: benefit from a reevaluation to mitigate potential monotony; potential adjustments could involve revising the sky-to-water ratio or implementing heightened contrast
samples.new_caption: a black and white photo of boats on calm water with intricate ripple patterns, dramatic high contrast, deep blacks and bright highlights, fine art monochrome photography, balanced sky-to-water composition
samples.aesthetic_target: increase contrast, balance composition, preserve B&W aesthetic

samples.scene_summary: silhouette figure with stroller on minimalist stairs (B&W)
samples.old_ip2p_prompt: A suggestion for further enhancement could involve selectively incorporate details within the vacant space on the right side to augment the visual depth and complexity
samples.new_caption: a black and white photo of a person silhouetted pushing a stroller on minimalist stairs, dramatic side lighting with strong shadows, deep contrast, fine art photography, balanced composition with subtle background texture
samples.aesthetic_target: dramatic lighting, depth, fill empty space subtly

csgo_inference_config.negative_prompt: text, watermark, lowres, low quality, worst quality, deformed, glitch, noisy, blurry

_notes.controlnet_conditioning_scale: InstantX 官方推荐 [0.8, 1.0], 用 1.0 保 inpainting 结构
_notes.guidance_scale: Qwen-Image 蒸馏引导, 默认 1.0 (不是经典 CFG)
_notes.true_cfg_scale: 真正的 CFG, 官方推荐 4.0
_notes.mask_strategy: full = 白色 mask 让模型重绘全图, 靠 ControlNet 锚定结构
